results.title: Sindh opposes Pakistan wheat import plan, urges use of local surplus - Daily Soon Times
results.description: Sindh has opposed the federal government's wheat import plan, saying local production and inter-provincial distribution should be prioritized to protect farmers and stabilize supplies.
